name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant Country-Roasted Half Chicken & Mashed Potatoes (Non-Fried Option!)
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Most visitors don't realize Mrs. Knott's lets you order their complete Full Chicken Dinner with **Oven-Roasted Half Chicken** instead of fried chicken—giving you tender, non-fried poultry, homemade chicken noodle soup, mashed potatoes, and warm buttermilk biscuits!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Country-Roasted Chicken Dinner** (instead of fried), choose **Chicken Noodle Soup** (skip the rhubarb starter and raw cabbage slaw), ask for gravy on the side, and swap the seeded boysenberry pie slice for vanilla ice cream or boysenberry sherbet (if strained).
watchOuts: Take a lactase enzyme for the mashed potatoes and biscuits, and remove the seasoned chicken skin if sensitive
